base: liquid white on top, liquid clear on bottom

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: start sky with a little yellow
steps.load: tap a very small amount into bristles
steps.motion: criss-cross strokes letting it run out

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add cad yellow to the sky colors
steps.load: add cad yellow without cleaning
steps.motion: run it out across the sky

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add yellow ochre and sweep up to the top
steps.load: add ochre without cleaning
steps.motion: sweep it all the way up

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add bright red and blend it into the ochre
steps.load: add a touch of bright red without cleaning
steps.motion: crisscross strokes along the top, then light blend

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: mix lavender for the lower sky
steps.load: load crimson and mix in a little blue

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: place lavender in lower sky
steps.load: lavender on the brush
steps.motion: touch in lightly
steps.rule: mostly crimson keeps the lavender from turning green against yellow

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add more blue down to the horizon
steps.load: add a small amount of blue without cleaning
steps.motion: sweep down to the horizon

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: very light blend of the entire sky
steps.motion: light blend across the sky

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: knife cloud shapes from pure white
steps.load: pull a flat roll off the blade
steps.motion: push hard and lay cloud shapes
steps.where: upper sky, some running down to the horizon

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: tap and blend the clouds lightly
steps.load: tap a little white into bristles
steps.motion: tap onto canvas, then light blend

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: sketch the major wave shape
steps.load: mix dark blue-crimson on the brush
steps.motion: sketch a basic curl shape
steps.where: where the major wave will live
steps.rule: placing the major wave first prevents later problems

steps.subject: water
steps.action: fill dark lavender along the horizon
steps.load: tap a little dark lavender into bristles
steps.motion: lay it along the horizon toward the wave
steps.where: horizon down to the major wave

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add blue to the dark lavender and fill the edges
steps.load: mix a little more blue into the brush
steps.motion: fill outward to the edges

steps.subject: water
steps.action: blend black and blue into lower water
steps.load: mix black and a little phthalo blue on the brush
steps.motion: put color in, then sweep across
steps.where: lower water, across to the other side
steps.rule: liquid clear keeps the color true; white medium would dilute it

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add dark color in the wave curl
steps.load: same brush
steps.motion: lay dark color into the curl
steps.rule: the curling wave needs dark tones

steps.subject: beach
steps.action: mix sand color and tap into bristles
steps.load: tap all three into bristles

steps.subject: beach
steps.action: blend sand color up into the water
steps.load: same loaded brush
steps.motion: blend up into the water color

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: knife tiny far-off waves and sparkles
steps.load: pull flat and cut across for a small roll
steps.motion: push with firm pressure so the blade bends
steps.where: far back in the distance, here and there

steps.subject: beach
steps.action: knife highlight on sand high points
steps.load: add more ochre and white, cut a teeny roll
steps.motion: graze the high points, barely touching

steps.subject: water
steps.action: knife sparkles where light hits the water
steps.load: mix a tiny bit of cad yellow into white, cut a tiny roll
steps.motion: touch in bright spots, barely touching

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add another breaking wave
steps.load: load a little white on the fan brush
steps.motion: sweep out, then gently blend back to form the trough

steps.subject: water
steps.action: sunlight streaks between the waves
steps.load: add a little bright yellow to the fan brush
steps.motion: lay it on, wipe fan, blend back
steps.rule: so the sunlight looks like it sits between the waves

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add little blue-white touches
steps.load: white with a least touch of phthalo blue on fan
steps.motion: drop in small touches with a rocking motion
steps.where: throughout the water, here and there
steps.rule: rocking motion suggests many small waves without much work

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub the eye of the wave
steps.load: load a lot of white with a touch of cad yellow
steps.motion: scrub hard, then work outward
steps.rule: the sketch keeps the wave center pure

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend wave center and shape it
steps.load: clean dry brush
steps.motion: tiny circles, then grab and pull to shape

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: pull big crashing wave
steps.load: white with a little cad yellow
steps.motion: grab and pull, wiping brush between strokes
steps.where: big crashing wave in the center
steps.rule: wiping between strokes keeps the color clean

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: scrub in lavender shadow
steps.load: a touch of lavender
steps.motion: scrub the shadow in and let it curve
steps.where: shadow under the foam, shaping the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add white-yellow foam highlight on top
steps.load: lots of white with a little yellow, wiped clean of blue
steps.motion: upward push, turn brush to use both sides

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: blend shadow into wave
steps.load: clean dry brush
steps.motion: tiny circles, blending into the shadow
steps.rule: leaving the outer edge unblended keeps it crisp

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add highlight on far side and pull down
steps.load: load the highlight color
steps.motion: pull down, letting it continue the wave
steps.rule: the two inch brush holds more hair and works nicer

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add foam highlights with a liner
steps.load: white with the least touch of phthalo blue
steps.motion: add highlights here and there along the wave

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add small foam patterns
steps.load: white with a little phthalo blue
steps.motion: small rocking foam strokes

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: lay foam at the wave base
steps.motion: rocking strokes, leaving holes in the foam
steps.where: foam along the base of the wave
steps.rule: openings let the sand and water show through

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: add dark line under the wave
steps.load: a little lavender on the script liner
steps.motion: dark line running under the wave
steps.rule: a dark line makes the wave pop

steps.subject: other: palm tree
steps.action: paint trunks
steps.load: load the fan full of van dyke brown
steps.motion: pull up from the bottom, two trunks
steps.where: one trunk runs off the canvas, second crosses the wave

steps.subject: other: palm tree
steps.action: add grey light up the trunk
steps.load: a little black and white for grey
steps.motion: stroke light up the trunk

steps.subject: other: palm tree
steps.action: flick dark marks up the trunk
steps.load: a little dark color on the liner
steps.motion: short flicks up the trunk

steps.subject: other: palm leaves
steps.action: thin black palm leaves
steps.load: black thinned with paint thinner to a runny ink
steps.motion: flick leaves out from the trunk tops
steps.rule: very thin paint lets the leaves pull out easily

steps.subject: other: palm leaves
steps.action: add more palm leaves
steps.load: same thinned black
steps.motion: flick a few more leaves and one small one
steps.where: around the palm tops and sides
